about: Each model is set up the way its maker documents. For most that is no instruction at all. Four community models come with a short setup from their maker and use it here. Below: where every reply in this set came from, and every configuration frozen as a whole ("frozen": model asked and reported, file and compression, route and who served it, system text or none with its hash, template, thinking, sampling, date asked). A rerun with any of these changed is a new configuration key, and votes are never added across keys. Paths are inside the two collections named under "sources". Each hash equals that collection's manifest; the build stops if one differs. No reply was edited, shortened or picked again.
